bval.reason: BVAL publishes its official standings on bval.org. This site added BVAL girls volleyball on November 14, 2026 and has not transcribed its 2025-26 final standings yet. We do not show standings or awards from third-party sources.

provenance.extraction: Standings: pdftotext -layout. All-league awards: By hand, from pdftotext -layout of each PDF; each row is [player, school, position, year] as printed.
notes: SCVAL girls volleyball, from scval.com/standings. Rows are in the PDF's own "SCHOOL by finish" order; nothing is recomputed, since the PDF carries no game-level data.
The PDF's "Overall record" column is empty, so every overallRecord is null.
Division membership is the 2025-26 PDF's, which is not the 2026-27 alignment; the page says which teams moved.
School spellings are the documents' own ("Mt. View", "Monta VIsta"); `slug` is the join key.
Grades are stored as 9-12 whatever the document wrote ("Jr", "Junior", "Soph", "Frosh", "11").
An overall award is stored as "Player, School, Position, Grade" from the document's four cells. Two players named for one award are two entries under the same title.
Records are W-L: a volleyball match cannot end level, so the PDF prints no ties and t is stored as 0.
The standings PDF's file name reads "2025-25"; its title and its rows are 2025-26's.

Each all-league document names an MVP and one all-league team with an honorable mention from each school; the varsity documents also name an Outstanding Senior, Junior, Sophomore and Freshman, who are on the team or the honorable mention list too. There is no second team.
The De Anza documents print a player's graduating class ("2028"), the El Camino ones her grade ("10"); both are stored as the grade.
The El Camino JV document spells Saratoga "Saratgoa" and prints the year of one of its players as "7", which is no high school grade, so that row has none.
The El Camino varsity document prints its Outstanding Freshman's position over two lines ("OH/O" and "PP"), read as OH/OPP.
JV membership is varsity's in both divisions.

provenance.extraction: Transcribed from the two pages' HTML, read 2026-11-16, leaving out the tables the standings page comments out: each row as printed, and checked against the pages row by row.
notes: WBAL girls volleyball 2025-26, from hs.wbalsports.org: the standings linked from https://hs.wbalsports.org/history.html and the all-league teams linked from https://hs.wbalsports.org/history.html. Rows are in the league's own order; nothing is recomputed.
The standings page prints a place for the first of two teams ranked level and leaves the next row's blank; the blank row takes the place above it (1, 2, 2, 4).
The standings print a league record and no overall record, so every overallRecord is null.
The all-league page prints each player as "Player, School" with no year or position, so every year and position is null.
Division membership is the 2025-26 pages' own, which is not the 2026-27 alignment; the page says which teams moved.
Presentation played in the WCAL in 2025-26 (`joinedSince`): no WBAL table of that season lists it.
School spellings are the pages' own ("Crystal", "Mercy"); `slug` is the join key.
Girls volleyball: the page prints matches played, a W-L record, a win percentage and games back; a match cannot end level, so t is stored as 0.
The page's freshman table is not stored, nor its boys table, which is commented out of its HTML.
The Foothill page names Co-Most Valuable Players, two entries under one title.

provenance.extraction: Transcribed from the pdftotext -layout text of both PDFs, read 2026-11-16: each row as printed, and checked against the PDFs row by row.
notes: WCAL girls volleyball 2025-26, from wcalsports.org: the standings linked from https://wcalsports.org/standings/ and the all-league teams linked from https://wcalsports.org/awardsrecords/. Rows are in the league's own order; nothing is recomputed.

The standings PDF is the WCAL's 2025-2026 archive, linked as "2025-2026" from wcalsports.org/standings/; the all-league PDF is its 2025-26 awards book, linked as "2025-2026" from wcalsports.org/awardsrecords/.
The PDF prints no place column: each table is in its own order, and `place` is the row's position in it.
Overall is the PDF's "Season" columns.
Presentation played in the WCAL in 2025-26 and is in the WBAL's Foothill division now; its rows keep its slug (`formerMembers`), and the page says it moved.
The PDF's freshman tables are not stored: the archive has varsity and JV only.
Girls volleyball tables of October 29, 2025: league wins and losses, then the season's. A match cannot end level, so records are W-L and t is stored as 0.

The awards are the PDF's "2025 WCAL Girls Volleyball All League Teams": a Player of the Year (printed "Player – School", with no year), a first team, a second team and an honorable mention (Name, School, Year, Position). The WCAL names no JV all-league team.
